acquisition_method.evidence: MS2 Data Independent Acquisition (DIA) was performed in the orbitrap at 60,000 resolution, maximum injection time of 55ms and AGC target of 1.0E6 ions.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Digestion mode was set to specific with trypsin allowing maximum of one missed cleavage.

collision_energy.evidence: We used HCD fragmentation (Olsen et al, 2007) with fixed collision energy of 30.

fragmentation_method.evidence: We used HCD fragmentation (Olsen et al, 2007) with fixed collision energy of 30.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: Peptides were separated on a 50 cm (2 µm particle size) EASY-Spray column (Thermo Scientific, UK), which was assembled on an EASY-Spray source (Thermo Scientific, UK) and operated constantly at 50oC.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: LC-MS analyses were performed on an Orbitrap Fusion™ Lumos™ Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, UK) coupled on-line, to an Ultimate 3000 HPLC (Dionex, Thermo Fisher Scientific, UK).

ptm.value: No PTMs are included in the dataset
